text_blocks.snippet: Shortness of breath is a common symptom of COVID-19 infection. It can occur due to the virus's impact on the lungs, which may cause inflammation and damage.
snippet_highlighted_words: Shortness of breath is a common symptom of COVID-19 infection

list.snippet: The virus infects the cells lining the airways in the lungs.
This inflammation causes the airways to narrow, making it harder for air to flow through.
The virus can also damage the alveoli (tiny air sacs) in the lungs, reducing their ability to exchange oxygen and carbon dioxide.
